parameters.query:
SELECT
  id,
  session_id,
  role,
  LEFT(content, 1500) || CASE WHEN LENGTH(content) > 1500 THEN '...' ELSE '' END AS content,
  created_at
FROM messages
WHERE session_id = '{{ $json.sessionId }}'
ORDER BY id ASC
LIMIT 10;
